data.one_liner: Provides detailed information about the current device, make, model, and OS version.
data.what_it_does: Fetches hardware and operating system details for the device running the app. It supports getting specific info for Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms.
use_when: You need to log device-specific metadata for crash reporting or analytics.
Your app needs to check OS versions or device models to conditionally enable features.
avoid_when: You need device state sensors or hardware controls instead of static details.
strengths: Supports all major platforms: Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Provides both strongly-typed platform getters and a generic data method.
weaknesses: The generic device info data map is not 100% JSON compatible or serializable.
Certain platform values (like user-assigned device names on iOS 16+) require special entitlements.
data.setup_notes: Requires meeting specific Java, Kotlin, and Gradle wrapper versions on Android, and minimum OS targets on iOS and macOS.
